description: This file defines the interface for the FreeType library's path stroker component, including types, enums, and function declarations for creating, configuring, and using a path stroker to generate stroked outlines of glyphs.

methods.name: FT_Outline_GetInsideBorder
methods.description: Retrieves the border index corresponding to the 'inside' borders of a given outline.

methods.name: FT_Outline_GetOutsideBorder
methods.description: Retrieves the border index corresponding to the 'outside' borders of a given outline.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_Set
methods.description: Resets a stroker object's attributes such as radius, line cap, line join, and miter limit.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_Rewind
methods.description: Resets a stroker object without changing its attributes, preparing for new path parsing.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_ParseOutline
methods.description: Parses a whole outline with the stroker, generating border outlines.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_BeginSubPath
methods.description: Starts a new sub-path in the stroker.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_EndSubPath
methods.description: Closes the current sub-path in the stroker.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_LineTo
methods.description: Draws a line segment in the current sub-path.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_ConicTo
methods.description: Draws a quadratic Bézier curve in the current sub-path.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_CubicTo
methods.description: Draws a cubic Bézier curve in the current sub-path.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_GetBorderCounts
methods.description: Retrieves the number of points and contours needed for a specific border.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_ExportBorder
methods.description: Exports a specific border outline to a user-provided FT_Outline.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_GetCounts
methods.description: Retrieves total points and contours for all borders.

methods.name: FT_Stroker_Export
methods.description: Exports all borders to a user-provided FT_Outline.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_Stroke
methods.description: Applies stroke to a glyph outline with a given stroker.

methods.name: FT_Glyph_StrokeBorder
methods.description: Applies stroke to a glyph outline, returning only inside or outside border.
